events.text: Before the new year every debt must be settled. Collectors knock on every door.

effects.log: You enter the new year clean.

choices.text: Help a neighbour hide from a cruel lender

effects.log: The lender goes away empty-handed.

events.text: Someone owes you money and has been avoiding you all year.

choices.text: Forgive the debt as a new year gift

effects.log: They weep, and bring you rice cakes every year after.
They pay, embarrassed. (+8 taels)

events.text: A loan shark's men are breaking a shopkeeper's stall over a small debt.

ok.log: The loan shark forgives the debt, very suddenly.

fail.log: You stop them, and pay for it in bruises.

effects.log: The stall survives. (−10 taels)

events.text: Your elders ask everyone to help balance the year's accounts.

effects.log: Someone has been skimming. You find out who.
Heavy books, light gossip.

events.text: An old friend reminds you of a favour you promised years ago.

effects.log: A week of work. Your word is still worth something.
They accept, disappointed. (−5 taels)

events.text: A stranger arrives: 'You saved my father years ago. I have come to repay the debt.'

effects.log: A fine sword wrapped in silk.

choices.text: Tell them the debt was paid by their father's smile

effects.log: They leave in tears.

events.text: Constables raid a smugglers' warehouse. The owner runs past you.

effects.log: The constables thank you.
Not your fight.

events.text: The whole town sweeps its houses to sweep away the old year's bad luck.

effects.log: A clean house and a lighter heart.
The monks give you a blessing.

events.text: You owe your friend three marbles. They want them back before the new year.

effects.log: Interest. Your friend is impressed.
A fair trade, they decide.

events.text: A bridge where debtors used to hide from collectors. Old names are carved under it.

effects.log: You join a long tradition of people who meant to pay.
Some are famous now. Everyone owes someone.

events.text: A merchant claims the ghost of a man he cheated visits him every night.

choices.text: Tell him to repay the widow

effects.log: He does. The ghost stops coming.
It is his own guilty snoring.

events.text: The last night of the year. Everything owed is paid, or forgiven.

effects.log: An apology, years late. They write back.
The year is over. You did your best.
